title: Audit and reduce recurring UI lag across startup, chat, and Agent presentation
context: Code audit found: RootView forced full AgentScreen identity reset on language changes and performed a redundant refresh after prepareActiveModel (whose run wrapper already refreshes after an actual load attempt); Chat nested its message ScrollView inside ScreenScaffold's vertical ScrollView; streamed text and metrics were published every 50 ms; AgentOrb ran repeating pulse/rotation and expensive blur/shadow layers while idle.
goal: Remove unnecessary full-screen resets and duplicate startup refreshes, give Chat one vertical scroll container with a fixed composer, reduce stream publication frequency, and stop repeating GPU animation when the Agent is not thinking.
forbidden_changes: Do not change inference/runtime behavior, provider calls, model settings, or permission policy.
Do not remove chat history or streaming output.
Do not change scroll behavior of screens other than Chat.
Do not change translations or language preference keys.
acceptance_criteria: Changing app.language updates locale without resetting AgentScreen identity.
Startup performs one initial refresh; model preparation remains responsible for refreshing after a real load attempt.
Chat has no competing outer vertical ScrollView and keeps its composer in the fixed layout.
Stream presentation is published at no more than 10 batches per second.
AgentOrb has no repeating pulse/rotation or animated particle/blur layers while not thinking.
Other screens keep the default scrollable scaffold.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Review Chat compact-layout and stream-scroll behavior; review Orb transitions into and out of thinking.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if compact Chat layout clips the composer or Orb animation does not start/stop correctly.
